descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_unbind: Clears the instance's bound marker and the bound flag on its scene node's render state.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_owner_value: Returns a word stored at offset 0x28 of the instance's owner record.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_set_tint: Copies a four-word colour into the instance's tint record and returns success.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_collect_visit: Visitor callback: adds mesh-class sources whose name does not start with a marker character, then continues the walk.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_collect: Walks a scene hierarchy with a visitor object to collect child meshes into the given instance.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_add_child: Appends a referenced child object to the instance's child array, growing it first.
descriptions.w3d_fn_80182408: Returns 0; likely a default virtual method.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_set_resource_value: Sets property 0x54 on the instance's node resource to the given value.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_reset_resource_value: Resets property 0x54 on the instance's node resource to its material default.
